# اِقْتَرَضْتِ (iqtaraḍti) /iq.ta.radˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اِقْتَرَضَتْ (iqtaraḍat) /iq.ta.ra.dˤat/: third-p
